about: One entry per spoken line of every explainer script and callbacks.json, keyed by script id and line id (README, "Line ids"). say is a hash of the speaker, say, cue and cue_at: the caption is left out, so a caption edit never asks for a new take. take is null until a take is accepted, then {say, provider, model, voice, direction, date, file, transcript}: say is the hash it was recorded from. A line that leaves a script moves to retired, and its id is never used again. Written by node tools/explainer-scripts.mjs --write-manifest.
